# Reference fixture provenance

`basic/` is a small tokenizer and template authored for these tests. It deliberately
uses token ID zero and explicit BOS/EOS post-processing. It is not a production tokenizer.

`qwen3.jinja` is the unmodified `chat_template` field from
[Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B tokenizer_config.json](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B/resolve/c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca/tokenizer_config.json),
revision `c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca`, by the Qwen team,
licensed under [Apache 2.0](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B/blob/c1899de289a04d12100db370d81485cdf75e47ca/LICENSE).
The original copyright notice is: Copyright 2024 Alibaba Cloud.
The root `LICENSE` contains the Apache 2.0 license text. Only the template is included;
no weights or production vocabulary are downloaded.

`huggingface-reference.json` is generated by `scripts/generate-reference.py` using
Transformers 4.57.1, Tokenizers 0.22.2, and Jinja2 3.1.6. It includes the source
templates so each expected string is self-contained. Tests compare UTF-8 bytes
and token IDs with stored Python results. These cover selected text/tool/thinking
paths, not every model or Jinja extension.
